verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a laptop processor, but the evidence does not deliver it. Qualcomm explicitly publishes no TDP or power figure and leaves power envelopes to OEMs. The only efficiency evidence is a press-release headline calling the chips the 'Most Efficient Processors', with no sustained-load data. No independent testing of sustained performance per watt appears in the pack, and community comments note the missing thermal design power data and benchmarks.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt
